Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1368
Claimant:
Frank Chan
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2024-04-03
Claim opened after a low-speed head-on collision reported by the claimant, who was driving the insured vehicle at the
time. The claimant reports a wrist injury and states they are not represented by an attorney.
2024-04-24
Reviewed the police report, which confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene. Scheduled a call to take a
full statement and request the claimant's mediacl records.
2024-05-30
Claimant gave a statement today and described the impact the same way as on first notice of loss. No new details
have emerged, and the account has stayed consistent across every conversation so far.
2024-06-10
Photos from the scene and the repair estimate show damage that lines up with the described impact. No independent
witnesses have come forward, so the photos are the main evidence of how the collision happened.
2024-06-26
Confirmed with the policyholder that the claimant lives in the household and is a listed driver under the policy, so
coverage applies to the claimant as a household member. Checked the policy effective history and found nothing
indicating the vehicle damage perdates the coverage start.
2024-07-05
Requested prior vehicle records and inspected the repair file. No earlier damage to the vehicle is on record, and
nothing in the file suggests a prior loss.
2024-07-17
Medical records received show a wrist fracture treated with a longer course of care than is typical for this injury.
Requested additional treatment notes to understand the timeline of care.
2024-09-02
Searcehd available records and asked the claimant about prior problems. No earlier injury to the same area of the
body is known, but the claimant's prior history is still being confirmed with the provider.
2024-09-04
The medical file does not yet establish whether the fracture was caused by this collision. Referred the file to the
medical review team for an opinion on causation and the link between the crash and the injury.
2024-10-19
Status remains open pending the medical review and the remaining treatment records. Will follow up with the
claimant once the causation opinion is back to discuss next steps.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
